heavy_packages.django: Consider Flask or FastAPI for lighter web frameworks.
heavy_packages.numpy: If only basic array ops are needed, explore `array` module or custom implementations.
heavy_packages.pandas: For simple CSV/data handling, `csv` module or custom parsing might suffice.
heavy_packages.requests: For basic HTTP, `urllib.request` is built-in and lighter.
heavy_packages.scipy: Heavy scientific library; only include if absolutely critical.
heavy_packages.tensorflow: Extremely heavy. Consider PyTorch Lite or ONNX Runtime for inference, or custom C/C++ for critical ops.
heavy_packages.pytorch: Similar to TensorFlow, very heavy. Optimize models for edge devices or use lighter frameworks.
